title: Functoriality of the etale H1 of G_m and the Picard group
statement: Let $X$ be a curve over an algebraically closed field $k$ and $Y$ a curve over an algebraically closed field $k'$ [def-sc-curves] (possibly $k\neq k'$), and let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $c_u:u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ be the comparison morphism of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$ adjoint to the pullback-of-units map $\mathbf G_{m,X}\to u_*\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and let $u^*$ be the cohomology pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Under the canonical isomorphisms $\operatorname{Pic}(X)\cong H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})$ and $\operatorname{Pic}(Y)\cong H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$ of [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic], the map $H^1(c_u)\circ u^*:H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})\to H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$ corresponds to pullback of invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-pc-module-pullback], $[\mathcal L]\mapsto[u^*\mathcal L]$; equivalently, it sends the class of the etale $\mathbf G_{m,X}$-torsor $\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal L)$ to that of $\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_Y,u^*\mathcal L)$. In degree zero, under $H^0=\Gamma$ [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero], $H^0(c_u)\circ u^*$ is pullback of global units $\mathcal O_X(X)^\times\to\mathcal O_Y(Y)^\times$.

source.place: Lemma 040E (Lemma 21.6.1), together with functoriality of cohomology under pullback

proof.text: Obtain the isomorphism between Mathlib module pullback and tensorPullback from uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward. Transport the existing invertibility instance across it. The Picard map is the torsor class of the generator torsor; rewrite using Pic.etaleTorsorClass_mk. Its class is independent of the chosen terminal object: represent a torsor as a lifting torsor, restrict the lifted section along the unique terminal map, identify the lifting sheaves, and use naturality of H.equiv-zero to identify their boundaries.

Apply clause (1) of etale torsor H1 functoriality to the generator torsor, obtaining T-prime, the sheaf isomorphism eT, its unit equivariance, and the equality of cohomology pullback with the class of T-prime. Apply lem-sc-etale-generators-pullback-equivariant to obtain a c_u-equivariant sheaf map from T-prime to the generator torsor of tensorPullback(u)(L). The existing classH1_eq_map_of_equivariant theorem identifies the coefficient image with that target torsor class. Rewrite the target class back to the canonical Picard identification.

In degree zero, transport H.equiv-zero along the unique maps between the explicit identity etale object and the chosen terminal object. Apply cohomologyMap_zero_eq_globalSectionsUpperStarMap, then H.equiv-zero coefficient naturality. Expand the global-section unit map, cancel the section/global-section isomorphisms, and apply naturality of the comparison. Its adjunction identity identifies the unit followed by the comparison with gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf. Naturality transports this calculation back to the explicit identity objects. The composite etale map m from Y to the pullback of X has m.left followed by the first projection equal to u, using m.w and the pullback condition. The formula for gmPresheaf restrictions and composition of appTop then gives exactly Units.map u.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom.

lean.statement: theorem picard_cohomology_pullback (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k'))] [IsCurve (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsCurve (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))] (u : Y ⟶ X) : (∀ (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible], ∃ h : ((Modules.tensorPullback u).obj L).IsInvertible, Sheaf.H.map (upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf u) 1 (Etale.cohomologyMap u X.gmSheaf 1 (Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroup X (Pic.ofIsInvertible L))) = Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroup Y (@Pic.ofIsInvertible Y ((Modules.tensorPullback u).obj L) h)) ∧ (∀ a : Γ(X, ⊤)ˣ, Sheaf.H.equiv₀ Y.gmSheaf (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale Y) (Sheaf.H.map (upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf u) 0 (Etale.cohomologyMap u X.gmSheaf 0 ((Sheaf.H.equiv₀ X.gmSheaf (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale X)).symm (ULift.up (Additive.ofMul a))))) = ULift.up (Additive.ofMul (Units.map u.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)))
